steps.prompt:
Edit this photo: make it evening. Make only these concrete changes:
1. The foreground floor near the camera falls into soft shadow, because the street behind the camera is now dark.
2. Overall exposure is about one stop darker; the ceiling and white surfaces become dimmer and warmer.
3. The three black dome pendant lamps over the counter are clearly switched on: bright warm bulbs visible inside, warm cones of light falling onto the counter top and onto the blue tiles below them.
4. The wall sconces on the right glow and cast warm light onto the wall.
5. Warm tungsten colour temperature overall, with deep blacks.
Keep everything else identical: same camera, framing, architecture, objects, people and materials. Do not change any text, sign, sack, logo or the flag. Do not add anything.
Photorealistic interior photograph, portrait 3:4.

branding_restoration.method: Real base-photo pixels pasted over AI-rendered regions: base upscaled to output width, position found by grayscale NCC search, per-channel colour statistics matched to the edit, feathered rectangular mask. Regions in base coordinates (x0,y0,x1,y1).
branding_restoration.note: The model garbled every text and turned the shelf plaque into an invented helmet; all five regions restored from the base photo. The plaque used colour statistics from a wider context box because its target region was an invented object.

assets.known_limits: Coffee bags on the back shelf keep AI-garbled small text; two real helmets on the back shelf remain, barely visible; the hook-rack helmet by the door was removed by the cleanup; original framing (shutter edge at the top).

params.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium cinematic coffee campaign photograph, landscape 16:9. Camera almost overhead, about 65 degrees down, very close to a low wide handmade ivory ceramic cup filled with freshly served BLACK FILTER COFFEE, translucent deep mahogany black liquid, with one subtle copper-gold crescent reflection and delicate concentric ripples. NO crema, no milk, no latte art. The entire cup and small elegant handle are visible, sitting on a very dark walnut table. Cup centered at 62 percent from the left, 56 percent from the top, occupies 45 percent of image height. Warm grazing sunlight from upper left, shadows with deep forest-green tonality, surrounding space falls into almost black. The frame should feel tactile, intimate, sculptural, expensive, like a large-format food cinematography film still, authentic ceramic glaze and luminous liquid with restrained steam. Strong chiaroscuro, high photographic realism, beautifully resolved fine texture. Left third kept dark and quiet for editorial type added later. Table edge not visible. Single cup, no saucer, no spoon, no beans scattered, no fruits, no ingredients, no hands, no people, no café interior, no packaging, no logo, no text, no typography, no watermark. This is the final frame of a camera pulling back from an extreme macro of the coffee surface.

params.prompt: One continuous premium coffee cinematography shot. Start exactly on the extreme macro first image: we are inside the dark surface of black filter coffee, a copper-gold ring ripple moving very gently. The camera smoothly dollies backward and rises, a dramatic but beautifully fluid change of scale. The coffee surface gets smaller, the real ivory ceramic cup rim gradually enters frame, then reveal the whole cup on the dark walnut table, arriving exactly at the supplied final frame. The liquid is always inside the SAME cup: no morph, no dissolve, no cut, no new objects. Subtle physically plausible surface ripples settling and delicate steam. Warm raking sunlight, deep forest-green shadows, cinematic chiaroscuro, photorealistic optical macro to medium shot. Keep the coffee dark, without crema, foam or milk. Cup remains stationary. No hands, no pouring, no ingredients, no text, no logos, no packaging, no sound. Camera eases to a complete rest in the last second. Preserve composition and lighting of the end frame.
